invariants: UI and route handlers never access MongoDB, EPS, or ImageKit directly; they call authorized application use cases.
Domain modules do not import Next.js/React or provider SDKs; infrastructure implements domain-owned ports.
Every customer/vendor/admin resource is authorized server-side and tenant scoped; deny by default.
Inventory hold/confirmation is atomic and cannot make sellable quantity negative under concurrency.
Money uses integer minor units plus currency; confirmed quote, policy, commission, and invoice snapshots are immutable.
Payment redirects are never payment truth; verified idempotent server events and provider verification decide state.
Ledger entries are append-only and balanced; historical commission/payment facts are never rewritten.
Every outbound call has timeout, redacted observability, and only safe bounded retry.
Private routes are noindex and uncached across identities; availability is revalidated before booking.
No production media hotlinks a reference host; managed property/content assets use ImageKit metadata and ownership.
Future service tabs cannot appear bookable or accept payment before their own verified milestone.
Verification never invokes npm run build, per repository governance.
freezeBoundary: The active PLAN.md milestone boundary; changes outside it require explicit scope expansion and a logged deviation.
